item.title: Habitat Network — Purple Moor Grass and Rush Pasture
item.description: Spatial extent of purple moor grass and rush pasture habitat across Northern Ireland, classified into Existing Habitat, Associated Habitats, Network Enhancement Zones, Fragmentation Action Zones and Network Expansion Zones. Part of the Nature Recovery NI habitat-network mapping project published by Ulster Wildlife on Open Data NI.
keywords: purple moor grass and rush pasture
